nodes.title: 1. Best Digital Transformation Bank – South Asia (2023)
nodes.summary: Winner of Best Digital Transformation Bank – South Asia 2023 from Asian Banking & Finance Magazine, for digital onboarding, the ZX Bank Asia mobile app, and the Zia AI chatbot.

nodes.title: 2. Excellence in Green Finance Award (2022)
nodes.summary: Received the Excellence in Green Finance Award 2022 from the South Asian Sustainable Finance Forum for green financing supporting Bhutan's hydropower and Nepal's solar ventures.

nodes.title: 3. Outstanding SME Bank – Sri Lanka (2022, 2023)
nodes.summary: Named Outstanding SME Bank – Sri Lanka for 2022 and 2023 by the Sri Lanka Banking Excellence Council for tailored SME lending and remittance services.

nodes.title: 4. Financial Inclusion Leadership Award – Bangladesh (2023)
nodes.summary: Won the Financial Inclusion Leadership Award – Bangladesh 2023 from the Bangladesh Microfinance Association for expanding digital banking, microfinance, and financial literacy in rural areas.

nodes.title: 5. Best Women’s Banking Initiative – South Asia (2023)
nodes.summary: Awarded Best Women's Banking Initiative – South Asia 2023 by the Women in Banking & Finance Network for micro-loan programs and financial empowerment for women-led enterprises.

nodes.title: 6. Top NRI Services Provider – Bhutan & Nepal Corridor (2023)
nodes.summary: Named Top NRI Services Provider for the Bhutan-Nepal corridor 2023 by the Asia Cross-Border Payments Council for fast remittance corridors and NRI account services.
